# BookVerse

Book discovery app using the Open Library API.
- `frontend/`: React (functional components, hooks)
- `backend/`: Node.js + Express REST API

## Review priorities (in order)
1. Correctness and bugs
2. Security
3. Error handling and edge cases
4. Maintainability and readability
5. Performance
6. Style (lowest priority; ESLint and Prettier handle most of it)

## Rules for all reviews
- Be specific: cite file and line, explain why it matters, suggest a fix.
- Do not invent issues. If code is fine, say so.
- Do not flag formatting that Prettier would fix.
- For code review tasks, follow .github/skills/bookverse-code-review/SKILL.md.
